allOf.description: Inherits shared step-base properties ($schema, id, owner, created_at, canonical_refs_used).

functional_requirements.description: Array of functional requirements derived from capabilities, each with acceptance criteria and trace links.

items.description: A single functional requirement with statement, acceptance criteria, and traceability.

fr_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this functional requirement (e.g., 'fr-user-login').

statement.description: Clear statement of the functional requirement, minimum 20 characters.

rationale.description: Explanation of why this requirement exists and what business need it addresses.

preconditions.description: Conditions that must hold before this requirement can be exercised.

postconditions.description: Conditions guaranteed after successful fulfillment of this requirement.

acceptance_criteria.description: Testable criteria that define when this requirement is satisfied, at least 2 required.

items.description: A single acceptance criterion with an ID, descriptive text, and optional fixture reference.

criterion_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this acceptance criterion.

text.description: Descriptive text of the acceptance criterion, minimum 15 characters.

fixture_ref.description: Optional reference to a test fixture that validates this criterion.

trace.description: Traceability links back to upstream capabilities or charter items.

items.description: A traceability reference for this functional requirement.

capability_ref.description: Canonical reference to the capability this requirement implements.

action_ref.description: Canonical reference to the action verb used in this requirement.

entity_ref.description: Canonical reference to the primary entity this requirement operates on.

status_ref.description: Canonical reference to the status lifecycle this requirement affects.
